context: Animated bar chart race showing World GDP rankings from 1993–2023 with playback controls and speed selection
first_impression: Deliberately designed with a purposeful Tol color palette, clean typographic hierarchy, and polished controls — well above generic defaults.
what_works: The Tol Bright/Muted palette is an accessibility-conscious, intentional choice that gives each country a distinct, harmonious color without resorting to schemeCategory10. Typographic hierarchy is genuinely considered: bold country labels, monospace value labels, quiet subtitle, and a large background watermark year all occupy distinct visual registers.
what_doesnt: Canada and China share the same $0.6T value and appear stacked in adjacent rows with nearly touching bars and labels — the y-position tiebreaking produces a visual collision that reads as a layout bug. The large year watermark floats in isolated empty space in the lower-right quadrant rather than anchoring compositionally to any chart element, making it feel like an afterthought despite the good instinct.
